perk: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Teams for students through eligible schools.
details: Sign up with a school email address. Device discounts and Microsoft 365 Personal student pricing vary by country.

name: Adobe Creative Cloud for Students
perk: Discounted Creative Cloud plans for students.

name: Spotify Premium Student
perk: Discounted Premium plan for verified students. Availability varies by country.
details: The Philippines is a supported country. Verification goes through SheerID.
requirements: Enrolled at an accredited higher-education institution
caveats: Must re-verify every 12 months, up to four years. Prices change, so none are listed here.

name: YouTube Premium Student
perk: Discounted membership for verified students. Availability varies by country.
details: Student pricing has been extended to the Philippines.
caveats: Prices have changed before, so none are listed here.

name: Apple Education Store
perk: Education pricing on Mac and iPad for students.
details: In the Philippines, Apple sells through its Philippine Education Store and verifies eligibility through UNiDAYS before checkout.
requirements: Verified higher-education student, parent buying for a student, or educator
caveats: Apple limits how many discounted items you can buy per year. Promos such as gift-card offers are time-limited.

name: Amazon Prime Student
perk: Discounted Prime membership for students. Availability varies by country.

name: Grammarly
perk: Check the site for current student or school-based pricing.

name: Philippine Airlines student discount
details: Under the Student Fare Discount Act, the discount applies while the student is enrolled. If PAL has a CAB-approved promo fare, you can choose between the promo fare and the regular fare minus the discount. Third-party sources report 20% off base fares on domestic flights.
requirements: Proof of enrollment, usually presented when buying the ticket
caveats: Reportedly excludes some low fare classes, promo fares, international routes and postgraduate or short courses. Check PAL's student discount page for current rules.

name: PAL Global Student Plus
perk: Discounted fares for international students aged 12 to 31.
details: A PAL program for students travelling abroad to study. Reported at around 10%.
requirements: Age 12 to 31, enrolled or accepted at an overseas school
caveats: Terms may have changed since the 2023 announcement. Confirm on PAL's site.
